scopeNote: Covers properties inside the City of Cincinnati. The code-enforcement table is shared across Hamilton County agencies, so it is filtered to the City of Cincinnati's own departments; Forest Park, Blue Ash, Norwood, Sycamore Township and county agencies are left out.

violations.coverage: Code-enforcement complaints handled by City of Cincinnati departments, about 721,000 entered 2000 to present: Public Services 38%, Trade and Development 21%, Health 21%, Buildings and Inspections 19%, Planning about 1% (shares counted 2026-10-14).

permits.coverage: City of Cincinnati building permits, about 181,000 applied for January 2010 to present.

source.name: City of Cincinnati Open Data
source.currentRecordsNote: Code-enforcement complaints and building permits are both published on the City of Cincinnati's open-data portal. The complaint table also carries other Hamilton County agencies' cases; only the city's own departments are searched here.
